_schema: Per-sub-game commit-reveal log for the replay viewer: every sealed step and the mutual-audit result, plus received_messages: the opponent turns this peer applied, filed as evidence and never part of the signature. Static team metadata lives in the declaration; join by game_uid.

links._remark: Logical roles, not fixed filenames. Names derive from game_id: declaration/result = <name>_<game_id>.json; per-sub-game config/log = <name>_<game_id>_g<NN>.json.
